Mr. Ravi Shivaji Jadhav, Psi, Bharati Vidyapeeth Police Station,
 Pune, present.

Coram: Madhav J. Jamdar, J.
 Dated : 19th September 2025

Heard Mr. Rajesh More, learned Counsel appearing for the Applicant and Ms. Savita Yadav,
learned App appearing for the Respondent-State.

2. This application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking
pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No.709 of 2021 registered at Bharti Vidyapeeth Police
Station, Pune, for the offence punishable under Sections 272, 273, 188 and 328 of the Indian Penal
Code, 1860 and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e) read with Sections 3(i)(zz)(v) and
30(2)(a) of the Foods Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A learned Single Judge by order dated 14 th July 2022 has granted interim protection to the Applicant.
The said protection is continued from last 3 and 1/2 years.
It is an admitted position that the chargesheet is filed in the year 2022.
